messages:
Asha (CS): Pinging a tiny customer-facing go-live handbook ("Go-lightning") — single page for SEs & CS to share. Focus: gentle prefill, tiny batch windows, streaming fallback, and renewal-signal capture. Will paste the minimal config and checks.
Diego (SE): Love the name. Can you include a 1-line rationale for each knob so customer engineers understand tradeoffs?
Asha (CS): yep — added inline comments. Minimal client config to give customers:
```json
{"prefill":true,"prefill_mode":"soft_progressive","prefill_seconds":30,"batch_window_ms":30,"max_batch_tokens":200,"stream":true,"client_heartbeat_s":20}
```
Asha (CS): quick rationales: prefill soft_progressive -> reduces cold p50 without big spikes; batch_window_ms small -> keeps interactive latency low; stream true -> progressive UI updates; max_batch_tokens caps memory.
Marta (Eng): infra notes: KV-cache TTL 600s for common prefixes, set warm-pool target 2 nodes for first 24h for mid accounts, and enable prefill jitter (uniform 0-300ms) to avoid synchronized bursts.
Owen (PM): add rollout safety: run a 10-prompt smoke eval 24h after go-live and whenever a model variant flips. If >2 failures, route that tenant to the stable variant and alert CS.
Asha (CS): troubleshooting snippets for SEs (paste to customers):
```bash
# verify SSE stream is sending events
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/verify?model=prod-1
# check for request id in logs
rg "x-request-id" /var/log/redwood/*
```
Kai (SRE): ops tip: if many tenants show identical prefill timestamps, increase jitter cap to 2s and stagger warm-pool jobs by tenant hash. Also watch prefill QPS spikes and auto-throttle prefill for tenants exceeding peak_qps by >25%.
Asha (CS): renewal-signal plan: short pulse survey 48h after go-live (3 Qs: accuracy Likert, latency ok Y/N + comment, hallucination observed Y/N + example). Negative answers auto-tag "renewal_risk" and queue CS outreach.
Diego (SE): sample traffic profile to hand to SRE when ramping:
```json
{"peak_qps":10,"avg_tokens_per_req":55,"interactive":true,"median_session_s":110}
```
Owen (PM): risk buckets (for playbook):
- green: normal (no action)
- amber: monitor + 72h check-in by CS (signals: usage drop 20-50% OR p95 >1.3x expected)
- red: immediate outreach + escalate to eng (signals: usage drop >50%, eval fails >2, repeated hallucination reports)
Asha (CS): automation: onboard-bot will kick a warm-pool prewarm job tagged with tenant_id at T+0 when onboarding label present. Also attach the one-pager to kickoff email.
Kai (SRE): I'll add a tiny runbook for warm-pool ops and a CLI script to trigger prefill per-tenant.
Asha (CS): I'll publish this as "Go-lightning: onramp pocket" and run a 20m sync next Tue for CS+SE to walk through handoff. Thanks all. Closing thread and moving the checklist into the playbook. /end
